title: Lesson 103 · Input and Output: Selecting Devices for Tasks
intro: Catch up on the key A Level ideas. Complete four retrieval questions, work through the examples, then practise and explain your reasoning.

questions.prompt: Choose the model answer: What does an input device do?
Choose the model answer: What does an output device do?
Choose the model answer: What is an actuator?
Choose the model answer: A 2×3 display grid: how many cells?

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: An input device captures data or a user action; an output device communicates information or changes physical conditions.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: A temperature sensor measures physical conditions; an actuator controls a physical action; a display shows values to the user.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Choose devices by required accuracy, accessibility, environment and response time. A touchscreen can perform both input and output functions.

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the choice
blocks.text: Input thermistor/temperature sensor; output fan/heater actuator, possibly a display.

blocks.title: Explain the choice
blocks.text: Input barcode reader or RFID reader; output display and optional printer.
